name: Tonga
description: Tonga, the only Pacific kingdom never colonised, from the Tuʻi Tonga empire to George Tupou I, British protection and the eruption of 2022.

checkpoints.name: The Tuʻi Tonga
checkpoints.note: The Tuʻi Tonga ruled an ocean empire. Cook visited in the 1770s.

checkpoints.name: The kingdom
checkpoints.note: George Tupou I united Tonga in 1845. It was never colonised, became fully independent in 1970 and more democratic in 2010.
